cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 70% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.57%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -0.81%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at +5.60%
cards.body: Leaders: SEDG +5.60%, NXT +5.16%, BE +4.79%, WFRD +3.32%, VRT +2.72%. Laggards: BWXT -2.83%, LNG -2.21%, NRG -1.58%, FLNC -1.39%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
